notes.text: 검사·시리즈·영상마다 전 세계 유일 UID(환자는 환자 ID)

source: DICOM PS3.3 Annex A, Composite Information Object Definitions (https://dicom.nema.org/medical/dicom/current/output/chtml/part03/chapter_A.html) — a Patient is the subject of one or more Studies; each Study is associated with exactly one Patient; a Study is a collection of one or more Series; each Series is associated with exactly one Study; all Composite Instances within a Series share the same Series information. UID 언급은 페이지 본문; Wikipedia DICOM(services, 1993 DICOM 3.0)
